prose: Christopher Gardner, aka Topher, has spent over a decade in Costa Rica building with bamboo, practicing permaculture and providing clients with geometrically harmonious structures for farming and living spaces. In this chat we talk about his vast experience with biodynamic and radionic principles, orgone technology, and consciousness expansion.
ext: We dive into the advantages of non-rectangular building styles, eating seasonally for health, the magic of water, radionics and ether physics, being a spiritual creditor, and the link between demonic possession and physical parasites.
